result.qa_status: PASS | PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS | FAIL; computed gate can downgrade

reviewer.name: nonempty actual identity
reviewer.method: actual visual/audio review method and coverage

result.inspected_evidence: list of {evidence_ref, clip_sha256, source_sha256, inspected: boolean, notes}; exact extracted-clip hashes

finding_checks.finding_id: existing finding ID; one per adverse finding

conclusion_review.notes: audit of conclusion and source-report consistency

result.issues: list of {severity: critical|major|minor, claim, source, finding, required_fix, owner}; all open critical/major issues block publication
result.limitations: list of nonempty strings; retained in final report
